about: The Android app's Vulkan renderer's components (port/android/VULKAN.md), in the form of #1183's port/notices/components.json: once that lands, these entries belong in its components list (requires: vulkan-android, the Android app).

components.name: libadrenotools
components.use: The Android app's Vulkan renderer: loading a Turnip driver in place of the phone's (display.vk_driver).

components.name: glslang (Android)
components.use: The Android app's Vulkan renderer: compiling the game's shaders to SPIR-V (libhalo_glslang.so, loaded at run time).
copyright: and the other copyright holders named below

components.name: Turnip (Mesa)
components.use: Not in the download: the open-source Vulkan driver for Adreno GPUs the Android app can download at the player's request (display.vk_driver = "auto"), from AdrenoToolsDrivers' releases.
